invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破$2050且RSI跌破50，或融资费率Z-score升至0%以上（空头压力缓解），或日线趋势恶化（如跌破$2000）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below $2050 with RSI falling below 50, or funding Z-score rises above 0% (short pressure eases), or daily trend worsens (e.g., breaks $2000).

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破$70000且RSI跌破50，或融资费率转为正且Z-score升至0%以上（空头压力缓解），或日线趋势恶化（如跌破关键支撑）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below $70000 with RSI falling below 50, or funding turns positive with Z-score rising above 0% (short pressure eases), or daily trend worsens (e.g., breaks key support).
